SELECT * FROM (
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS03}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.CCY, T4.BASIS, T4.INT_RATE, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.TRADER, T4.FINPROD_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T5.TYPE_6,
T1.CHL_ID,
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 , DATE_FORMAT(T1.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(T1.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') vDate, DATE_FORMAT(T1.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') mDate, NULL TERM, T3.THEORY_PRIN, T1.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, DATE_FORMAT(T1.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SETTLE_DATE, T3.THEORY_INT, T3.THEORY_AMT,
T1.FPRICE_AMT TRADE_AMT
FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF02}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF03}) and t1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and t1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} AND T1.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL and T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND (T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (#{item} ) or T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IN (#{item} ) )
ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC )
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS01}' statusValid, null busiCode, T1.CCY, T4.BASIS, T4.INT_RATE, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.TRADER, T4.FINPROD_ID, SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID, SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T5.TYPE_6,
T1.CHL_ID,
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 , DATE_FORMAT(T1.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(T4.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') vDate, DATE_FORMAT(T4.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') mDate, T4.TERM, T1.PRIN_AMT THEORY_PRIN, T1.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, null SETTLE_DATE, T4.M_INT_AMT THEORY_INT, T1.PRIN_AMT + T4.M_INT_AMT THEORY_AMT, null TRADE_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T31 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T31.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO SUBT2 ON SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T31.PORTFOLIO_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE t1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF02}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF03}) and t1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} AND T1.PS = #{PS_T01} AND T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID is null AND SUBT2.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' and (T2.PORTFOLIO_ID or SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN (#{PST22}, #{PST23}) AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF02}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF03}) and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and TPD.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID )
AND (T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (#{item} ) or SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (#{item} ))
ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC )
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS05}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.CCY, T4.BASIS, T4.INT_RATE, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.TRADER, T4.FINPROD_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T5.TYPE_6,

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS06}' statusValid, T1.P_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.CCY, T4.BASIS, T4.INT_RATE, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.TRADER, T4.FINPROD_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T5.TYPE_6,
T1.CHL_ID,
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 , DATE_FORMAT(T1.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(T1.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') vDate, DATE_FORMAT(T1.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') mDate, NULL TERM, T3.THEORY_PRIN, T1.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, DATE_FORMAT(T1.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SETTLE_DATE, T3.THEORY_INT, T3.THEORY_AMT,
T1.FPRICE_AMT TRADE_AMT
FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON T1.FINPROD_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF02}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF03}) and T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and t1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} and t1.PS = #{PST07}
